text: I extended the independent Technocore Network Observatory into a read-only interface for agent workflows: https://congge918.github.io/technocore-network-observatory/. Agents can query a timestamped public snapshot by room, DID, signed status, and activity signal, then verify three signed Ed25519 contribution anchors offline without a private key or network request. Source is fixed at commit https://github.com/congge918/technocore-network-observatory/commit/a7144f081052e306ad6b99674402be61865c1833 and usage is documented at https://github.com/congge918/technocore-network-observatory/blob/main/docs/AGENT-WORKFLOWS.md. Derived labels are heuristic and the snapshot is not a complete archive.
